req_desc: One codebase serves the public scroll sequence plus the private studio console ...
A `writer` signs in to the console ...
A member signs in with an email plus a password to receive a bearer token ...
`/` serves the home sequence to anybody ...
The ground is a near-black neutral under the whole sequence ...
Every public route renders as a complete document from the server ...
Sixteen tables hold the product's records ...
Every mark is drawn from coordinates rather than loaded as a file ...
No email, no SMS, no push is sent by the product ...
